<section class="s-overlap s-panel" aria-labelledby="chain-h">
<div class="s-head">
<h2 id="chain-h" class="s-h2 s-small">How a note reads <span class="s-h2-cn">标签约定</span></h2>
<a class="s-link" href="Mathematical-Foundations-of-Machine-Learning/6%20SGD,%20Momentum,%20and%20Potential%20Dynamics.html">From: SGD, Momentum, and Potential Dynamics
<svg class="s-icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M5 12h14M13 6l6 6-6 6"/></svg></a>
</div>
<ol class="s-chain">
<li class="is-definition">
<div class="s-step-head"><span class="tag-chip tag-definition">Definition</span><span class="s-step-num">I</span></div>
<p>设目标函数为 <span class="s-math"><i>f</i>(<i>x</i>)</span>，将其解释为势能地形 (Potential Energy Landscape)。</p>
</li>
<li class="is-theory">
<div class="s-step-head"><span class="tag-chip tag-theory">Theory</span><span class="s-step-num">II</span></div>
<div class="s-eq"><i>F</i>(<i>x</i>) = −∇<i>f</i>(<i>x</i>)</div>
<p>地形诱导的力。</p>
</li>
<li class="is-inference">
<div class="s-step-head"><span class="tag-chip tag-inference">Inference</span><span class="s-step-num">III</span></div>
<div class="s-eq"><i>x</i><sub><i>k</i>+1</sub> = <i>x</i><sub><i>k</i></sub> − <i>η</i> ∇<i>f</i>(<i>x</i><sub><i>k</i></sub>)</div>
<p>令 <span class="s-math"><i>η</i></span> → 0，差商收敛到时间导数。</p>
</li>
<li class="is-result">
<div class="s-step-head"><span class="tag-chip tag-result">Result</span><span class="s-step-num">IV</span></div>
<p>梯度下降是梯度流 (Gradient Flow) 的前向 Euler 离散化。</p>
</li>
</ol>
</section>
